card.name: FDA before approved test wording
card.fires_on: The word FDA (or the 'or' just before 'cleared by the FDA') right after 'using' or 'an' when the text asks for a diagnostic test, as in 'using an FDA-approved test'.

modes.label: FDA before test approval
modes.description: FDA directly follows 'using' or 'an' and leads into 'approved', 'cleared' or 'authorized' test.
modes.example: Perform using<< FDA>>-approved tests by laboratories with demonstrated proficiency.

modes.label: Information on FDA tests
modes.description: FDA follows 'Information on' in a pointer to a list of approved tests.
modes.example: Information on<< FDA>>-approved tests is available at: http://

card.writes: It adds a push toward words about guidance or official wording, though the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on 'FDA' when a label says to use an FDA-approved, cleared or authorized test.
